description: This Java source file defines a Swagger API documentation class for the CollectionSheet API in the Apache Fineract project. It contains nested static classes representing request and response schemas with annotated schema descriptions and example values.

classes.name: CollectionSheetApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: A final class containing nested classes to define Swagger schemas for CollectionSheet API requests and responses.

classes.name: PostCollectionSheetRequest
classes.description: Schema for posting a collection sheet request, including nested class for bulk repayment transactions.

classes.name: PostCollectionSheetRequest.PostCollectionSheetBulkRepaymentTransactions
classes.description: Defines the schema for a bulk repayment transaction within the collection sheet request, including fields like loanId, transactionAmount, paymentTypeId, and receiptNumber.

classes.name: PostCollectionSheetResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after posting a collection sheet, including nested class for changes details.

classes.name: PostCollectionSheetResponse.PostCollectionSheetChanges
classes.description: Details about changes returned in the response, including locale, date format, and transaction lists.
